The GSFC Earth Fact Sheet gives the sidereal orbital period as 365.256 days and the tropical (solar) year as 365.242 days; both differ from 365.25.
The science.nasa.gov page does not distinguish sidereal from tropical year; it uses 365.25 in the context of explaining calendar leap years.
The Gregorian calendar averages 365.2425 days/year (adding a leap day every 4 years except centuries not divisible by 400), which is a further refinement not mentioned on the selected page.
